title: Service Credit Schedule for Missed Standing Deliveries (Office Pantry & Beverage Program)
content:
Three figures govern credits on the Office Pantry & Beverage Program: what one missed standing delivery earns, how much may be credited in one billing period, and how long a claim remains acceptable.

| Tier | Credit for each missed standing delivery, as a percentage of the monthly programme fee | Ceiling on credits in one billing period, as a percentage of the monthly programme fee | Calendar days after the covering invoice within which a credit claim is accepted |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coffee & Tea Service | 8.00 | 25.00 | 14 |
| Standard Snack Pantry | 10.00 | 30.00 | 14 |
| Fresh Pantry Program | 12.00 | 35.00 | 21 |
| Barista Bar Program | 14.00 | 40.00 | 21 |
| Full Hospitality Pantry Program | 15.00 | 45.00 | 30 |
| Campus Pantry Network Program | 11.00 | 35.00 | 30 |

Both percentages are stated against the monthly programme fee of the tier concerned rather than against the invoice total. The claim window is stated in calendar days counted after the covering invoice.

Question: do the two percentages always rise together with the tier?
Answer: they rise together through the first five tiers, from 8.00 percent and 25.00 percent on Coffee & Tea Service to 15.00 percent and 45.00 percent on Full Hospitality Pantry Program, and then fall together on Campus Pantry Network Program, which is printed at 11.00 percent for each missed standing delivery and 35.00 percent for the billing period, while keeping the 30 calendar day claim window of the tier below it.
